scope: Forty-five mixed-national largest/greatest adjective forms in the base papers.
choice: Normalize the complete adjective set to the official veliky to večši to največši paradigm, inflecting the one feminine singular and the neuter/plural sites by sentence agreement.
motivation: The corpus mixed ć, č, j and bare-stem national forms. Official grammar specifies irregular večši, naj- superlative formation, soft-stem inflection, and gender/case/number agreement.
alternatives_rejected: A blind stem swap would turn three neuter-plural podpolja contexts into feminine singular.
Retaining national ć/j variants leaves an internally split adjective paradigm.
The separate frequency adverb največestěje is not part of this adjective paradigm and is assigned its own semantic repair.
